text:
Maria P: Heads-up: planning a small rollout to the dedicated GPU pool dpool-4 tonight at 21:00 UTC. This is a config-only change to the autoscale policy (burst_allowance +10%, eviction_threshold -5%). No model binaries updated. Target window 21:00-21:30 UTC. @Alex K can you run smoke checks? @Chris L you'll own rollback readiness. :eyes:

Alex K: Got it. I'll be on the watch during the window. Will run the smoke checklist and watch per-pool token latency + GPU utilization.

Chris L: I'll stand by and prepare the rollback plan. If anything crosses error-rate+latency thresholds we revert to previous policy.

Samir R: Couple quick q's: 1) Which pools/slices are affected (low vs default)? 2) Any config propagation delay we should expect?

Maria P: Affected: dpool-4 slices: default & low-priority-slices. Propagation is via config-service; typical propagation 15-45s, but we should assume up to 2m.

Alex K: Smoke checklist (I'll run in order):
```
# verify deploy state
kubectl -n infra get cm autoscale-config-dpool-4 -o yaml
# quick inference smoke
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.local/v1/generate -d '{"model":"gptx-sm","input":"smoke test"}' | jq '.status'
# per-pool metrics snapshot
python infra/tools/pool_metrics_snapshot.py --pool dpool-4 --out /tmp/dpool4-smoke.json
```
I'll post results here.

deploy-bot: config-service: rolling update of autoscale-config/dpool-4 initiated by @Maria P at 2025-11-06T21:00:12Z. Change id: cfg-az3b2.

Alex K: kube config looks applied. CM shows burst_allowance: 0.10, eviction_threshold: 0.45 (was 0.50). Ran quick inference: status OK, sample latency 180ms. Metrics snapshot uploaded to /tmp/dpool4-smoke.json. No obvious errors. :white_check_mark: 

Samir R: Noted. Any p99 token latency deltas?

Alex K: p50 ~ +8ms, p95 ~ +20ms, p99 ~ +45ms on default slice; low-priority slices show more variance but within expected. Keeping an eye.

Chris L: Rollback steps (ready):
1) set autoscale-config-dpool-4 back to cfg-az3a9 (previous)
2) force config-service sync: `./infra/scripts/config-sync --pool dpool-4 --force`
3) validate with the same smoke checklist and monitor for 5m
If deploy-bot reports errors or >3% error rate or p99 increase >200ms I will execute.

Maria P: Thanks. If Alex sees anything weird escalate to #eng-oncall and ping me + Chris. If everything looks good at +10m we'll let it graduate.

Alex K: At +12m: metrics steady, no error spike. Smoke inference okay. Marking as canary passed. :tada:

deploy-bot: autoscale-config/dpool-4 rollout completed at 2025-11-06T21:12:34Z. change id: cfg-az3b2.

Maria P: Cool — thanks all. I'll schedule the wider pool-cutover next week with a longer window. For now closing this canary. :shipit:
